title: Internal application-send turn policy force seam
purpose: Define the construction-time forced identity seam for application-send turn campaigns without changing the default scheduler or enabling active policy selection.
design_summary: LegacyCurrent retains the null fast path. Conservative installs the existing current planner solely as a distinct, internal campaign identity. The runtime accepts one mode before traffic, rejects any replacement of a caller-injected planner, and rejects non-legacy turn forcing while receive-credit shadow mode is active. Existing planner validation and all send/runtime guards remain authoritative.
risks: A force seam could be mistaken for an active selector; the mode is internal, one-shot, and has no observation-driven consumer.
Interface dispatch in conservative mode is campaign-only and is not the shipped default.
